scope: App-owned symbols documented in icons.md. Native system chrome retains OS glyphs; this does not inventory every decorative vector in every screen.
reuse: Clone the master; change only semantic tint, optical size or documented selected weight. Add new roles to Foundations and this registry before using them in screens. Structural clones are not live-linked.
native: SF Symbols for action/navigation roles; native ProgressView for loading and custom AI assistance badge. Paper vectors are reference geometry, not production font assets

settings.paperGeometry: Repaired shared eight-tooth outline; retained22-point wrappers, semantic tints and1.7/2.35 strokes

checkedCalendar.semantics: Plan a day action variant; not a save/completion receipt or selected tab weight

aiBadge.exception: Focused assistance badge; never a navigation or save-status icon

variants.semantics: Shared indeterminate circular progress; not an SF Symbol or completion receipt

verification: Editing/media and response rows inspected as static Paper screenshots; final context row and profile variants checked separately. No claim of a repo-wide icon migration or native glyph verification.

foundationsLibrary.registeredMastersAfter: All 34 prior roles and selected variants remain under 4MI-0 per cleanup registeredMastersAfter; seven new role masters and checked-calendar variant verified separately by parent and worker

usageEvidencePolicy.sourceEvidenceNotation: V1 or V2: nodeId@sourceRoot; representative cached canonical/reference occurrence joined to finalRoots and originalNodePageChanges for current phase; sourceRoot may be historical after subtree relocation
usageEvidencePolicy.phaseUse: Actual canonical/reference occurrences only; Foundations masters excluded. No inference that a V1 feature is absent because its icon is not observed
usageEvidencePolicy.counts: Snapshot/reference occurrences including hidden glyphs and nested exports, not unique current visible native instances; ancestor display:none not exhaustively interpreted

geometry.limits: All supplied cached exports plus four added preference roots; no all-current-live raster/glyph migration or exact Apple asset certification. SVG wrappers and CSS check/Stop candidates classified; ordinary borders, radio dots, switches, slider thumbs, home indicators and grabbers are controls, not icon roles

variantSemantics.default: Retain each registered selectedNodeId; selected optical weight/tint is not a different semantic role. Geometry signatures/size/stroke variants in source artifact are reference vectors, not native asset certification
variantSemantics.agent: Single sparkle navigation/assistance role; larger empty-state sparkle is a documented decorative alias
variantSemantics.profile: Person-circle outline and circle/head geometry share identity semantics
variantSemantics.search: Magnifier geometry/size variants share search semantics
variantSemantics.plus: Plus stroke/size variants cover add and attachment alias
variantSemantics.back: Backward-chevron optical variants retain source-return meaning
variantSemantics.bookmark: Save/unsave state and filled/outline geometry, V2 only
variantSemantics.chevron: Forward disclosure and next-response alias; not down-chevron
variantSemantics.check: SVG and CSS border checks represent selection/confirmation, not a new role
variantSemantics.calendar: Selected weight differs from checkedCalendar Plan a day action variant; no confirmed-save claim
variantSemantics.send: Up-arrow send action; jumpToLatest is a separately assigned down-arrow role
variantSemantics.stop: Filled square SVG/CSS control means interrupt response, not Close
variantSemantics.clock: Time and Wear insights action; not only timestamp decoration
variantSemantics.tag: Tag and private Style action; not limited to social tagging
variantSemantics.context: T-shirt context/category/make-look aliases; not evidence of actual garment record
variantSemantics.waveform: Voice input state, not fabricated recording activity
variantSemantics.aiBadge: Custom assistance badge exception retained at FZ3-0, never save-status or navigation
variantSemantics.rotatePhoto: Counterclockwise media edit, distinct from clockwise Retry
variantSemantics.chevronDown: Down disclosure/collapse, distinct from forward navigation
variantSemantics.delete: Destructive trash action; native destructive confirmation owns behavior
variantSemantics.progress: Native ProgressView circular indeterminate control; no SF Symbol assignment
